purpose: Construct a presentation-independent runtime carrier whose element identity depends only on the chosen invariant projection and invariant value.

factorization_semantics.factors_through_invariant_carrier: Every presentation in an invariant sector has the same canonical carrier image.
factorization_semantics.carrier_factorization_held: At least one presentation lacks an observed invariant image.
factorization_semantics.carrier_factorization_obstructed: The related sector contains more than one invariant carrier image.
factorization_semantics.local_presentation_canonical_image: A singleton presentation has a canonical carrier image but no nontrivial quotient claim.

next: factor later runtime semantics through carrier elements instead of provider presentations, then compare alternative carrier models only by invariant-preserving equivalence
